_설명: 탑20 롱폼 C편 「혼주 이미지와 뒤꽂이」 장면 사양(2026-11-16). 가로 16:9, 1920×1080. 소리는 narration-image.json — scenes 의 lines 는 그 파일 lines 의 줄 번호(0부터)다. 문장 한두 개에 그림 한 장. kind: title(장 제목 화면 — 다음 그림을 흐리게 깔고 제목), summary(장 한 줄 요약 화면 — bg 로 적은 그림 번호를 흐리게 깔고 요약 + 잇는 문항), still(정지 그림에 느린 확대·이동), clip(그 그림을 시작 프레임으로 한 Veo 3.1 Fast 8초 컷), lock(끝 화면). 그림 번호는 still·clip 을 나오는 순서대로 1부터 센다(img-NN.jpg, clip-NN.mp4). cap 은 소리 글과 화면 글이 다른 줄만 적는다. 사람은 뒷모습만 그리고, 물건 컷에는 손도 사람도 없다. 그림에 글자·숫자 없음.

style.img_style: Korean ink-and-wash illustration (damchae): fine, confident sumi ink linework with soft transparent watercolor washes, visible hanji mulberry-paper texture across the whole image, gentle color bleeding at the edges, generous empty paper space. Warm cream and muted gold palette; the hanbok silks and the hair ornaments carry the only strong colors. Modern, elegant, refined — a contemporary wedding setting, not an old-fashioned folk painting. Single full-bleed illustration, no borders, no seal stamps, no calligraphy. Horizontal 16:9 landscape composition; keep the bottom fifth of the frame calm and uncluttered for captions. Not photorealistic, not 3D, not anime.
style.banned_person: Exactly one person in the frame, seen only from behind — her face is never visible, no profile, no mirror reflection. No text, letters, numbers, logos or signs anywhere. No kimono, no obi, no Chinese hanfu, no western church altar, no gold-foil patterns all over the hanbok. No rings, no nail art.
style.banned_object: NO people at all, no hands, no figures, no faces anywhere — an object-only still life or empty interior. No text, letters, numbers, logos or signs anywhere. No gold-foil patterns.
style.look: The woman: Korean mother of the bride in her late 50s, short pale pink silk jeogori with long goreum ribbon, deep magenta full chima, dark brown hair in a neat low chignon; seen only from behind, face never visible.
style.look_wavy: The woman: Korean mother of the bride in her late 50s, short pale pink silk jeogori with long goreum ribbon, deep magenta full chima, dark brown hair; seen only from behind, face never visible.
style.clip: Static camera, no zoom, no cut. Keep exactly the same scene, person, hanbok and Korean ink-and-wash illustration style (fine ink lines, soft watercolor washes, hanji paper texture stay visible the whole time; never becomes photorealistic or 3D) as the start frame. {m} Her face is never visible. Only small, natural movement. No new people, no new objects, no text, no camera shake.
